<!--
House rule 0, and the one most often forgotten: EVERY Chinese character gets an
English rendering beside it, every time — 為 (wéi — "to do / to handle"), never a
bare 為. Including in this issue. I do not read Chinese fluently, and unglossed
Chinese turns a question into one I cannot answer.
-->

  · consistency with the locks and with how the term reads elsewhere
Gloss every character you cite.
